purpose: Preregistered local confirmation against frozen champion; synthetic outcomes only. No platform promotion.

design.primary: k=1 paired seat win rate, two-sided exact McNemar plus conservative paired interval
design.secondary: k=3 each faction isolated against frozen other-side seats; one outcome per table/role
design.ci_notes: ci95 is paired normal approximation; conservative_ci95 is a Bonferroni difference of Wilson 97.5% intervals. Binary role/table outcomes only have exact McNemar.
design.multiplicity: Opponent/regression scans are unadjusted conservative warning screens; exploratory slice gains must not be treated as globally corrected discoveries.

default/rt.command: ARENA_RECORD=0 ARENA_STATE=0 ARENA_WW_TACTICS=off .venv/bin/python -m local.werewolf_benchmark --candidate agent --reference champion --candidate-env ARENA_WW_TACTICS=off --split heldout --seeds 28101 28102 --games 1000 --backgrounds first,random,heuristic,llm,llmx,llmq,mixed,rt_wolfpack,rt_talker,rt_detective,rt_chaos --ks 1,3 --timing rt --jobs 3 --trace-games 3 --out logs/werewolf_benchmarks/confirmation-default-rt-28101-28102

default/rounds.command: ARENA_RECORD=0 ARENA_STATE=0 ARENA_WW_TACTICS=off .venv/bin/python -m local.werewolf_benchmark --candidate agent --reference champion --candidate-env ARENA_WW_TACTICS=off --split heldout --seeds 28101 28102 --games 400 --backgrounds first,random,heuristic,llm,llmx,llmq,mixed,rt_wolfpack,rt_talker,rt_detective,rt_chaos --ks 1,3 --timing rounds --jobs 3 --trace-games 3 --out logs/werewolf_benchmarks/confirmation-default-rounds-28101-28102

public-vote/rounds.command: ARENA_RECORD=0 ARENA_STATE=0 ARENA_WW_TACTICS=off .venv/bin/python -m local.werewolf_benchmark --candidate agent --reference champion --candidate-env ARENA_WW_TACTICS=public_vote --split heldout --seeds 28101 28102 --games 400 --backgrounds first,random,heuristic,llm,llmx,llmq,mixed,rt_wolfpack,rt_talker,rt_detective,rt_chaos --ks 1,3 --timing rounds --jobs 3 --trace-games 3 --out logs/werewolf_benchmarks/confirmation-public-vote-rounds-28101-28102

rt.scope: Secondary decomposition on the same fixed deals; includes all preregistered slices, no selection, no separate promotion gate.

rounds.scope: Secondary decomposition on the same fixed deals; includes all preregistered slices, no selection, no separate promotion gate.

secondary_multiplicity_check.method: Bonferroni over all reported binary opponent exact McNemar tests, including correlated pooled and per-k slices; conservative, not a new promotion gate.
